title: Plain Steamed Rice
description: Simple, fluffy steamed basmati rice — the default carb for any dal or curry that doesn't need a flavoured rice.
steps: Rinse the basmati rice under cold water until it runs mostly clear, then soak for 15-20 minutes and drain.
Add the drained rice, water, salt and ghee (if using) to a heavy-bottomed pot.
Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce heat to low. Simmer for 12-15 minutes without lifting the lid.
Turn off the heat and let the rice rest, covered, for 5 minutes.
Fluff gently with a fork before serving.
